Awesome System Design Resources

This repository contains free resources to learn System Design concepts and prepare for interviews.

👉 Subscribe to my AlgoMaster Newsletter and get a FREE System Design Interview Handbook in your inbox.

✅ If you are new to System Design, start here: System Design was HARD until I Learned these 30 Concepts

⚙️ Core Concepts

aiSummary.oneLiner: A curated repository of high-quality resources for mastering complex system design concepts and interview preparation.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Awesome System Design Resources is a meticulously curated repository that aggregates high-quality materials for mastering complex system architecture. It provides developers and engineers with an extensive collection of structured guides, comprehensive case studies, and detailed tutorials focused on building scalable systems. The repository covers critical topics such as load balancing, caching mechanisms, database sharding, and distributed microservices architecture. By organizing the best available educational materials, it serves as an indispensable reference for tackling difficult engineering interviews and designing robust production applications.
keyFeatures: Extensive Topic Coverage: Deeply covers critical system design concepts including load balancing, caching, database sharding, and complex distributed architecture.
Curated Educational Materials: Aggregates highly rated tutorials, comprehensive video lectures, and in-depth articles from leading software engineering experts.
Real-World Case Studies: Features detailed architectural breakdowns of massive scalable systems utilized by major technology companies like Netflix and Uber.
Structured Learning Paths: Organizes complex resources into logical learning paths tailored for different skill levels and interview preparations.
Community-Driven Updates: Continuously refreshed and updated by a large community of experienced software engineers to ensure high relevance.

useCases.description: Backend developers reference the detailed guides to properly design and implement highly scalable, fault-tolerant architectures for new production applications.

useCases.title: Continuous Professional Education
useCases.description: Experienced architects continuously browse the curated materials to stay updated on the latest industry best practices and modern distributed technologies.

useCases.title: Deep Technical Reference
useCases.description: Engineering teams actively consult the real-world case studies to thoroughly understand how massive tech giants previously solved highly specific scalability challenges.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This repository is designed for software engineers, backend developers, and system architects aiming to deeply understand large-scale system design. It is highly valuable for candidates actively preparing for technical interviews at major technology companies.
